envelope.description: Map every builtin onto the approval field

body.title: Map every builtin onto the approval field
body.summary: Rewrite the builtins: requiresApproval true becomes approval 'common', each of the 7 predicates becomes a per-input function returning common or none, requiresApproval false or absent becomes none (the field is dropped), and the 8 destructive: true builtins (cloud az/vm, k8s, aws s3, gcp compute, aws cloudformation, gcp run, gcp storage, aws ec2) become approval 'destructive'. Include src/docgen/tool.ts. Then remove requiresApproval and destructive from the Tool type. A script-assisted, mechanical change that keeps every tool id and input schema; a snapshot of tool id, input schema and old flag taken before the rewrite is kept as a test fixture.
acceptanceChecks: no file under src declares requiresApproval or destructive
every former requiresApproval true tool is common, every predicate tool is per-input, every former false or absent tool resolves to none (no read-only tool asks)
the 8 destructive builtins resolve to destructive
the snapshot taken before the rewrite matches the new approval field for every tool, and the list of tool ids and input schemas is identical
npm run build and the existing builtin tests pass
